name: agentplugins
description: Reusable Claude Code plugins from codewandler.

plugins.name: flux-agent
plugins.description: Drive the flux agent (codewandler/flux) as a sub-agent over its NDJSON line protocol instead of scraping rendered prose. A skill teaches the trust rules for an unattended flux run — the exit code and a clean `turn_end` both report success when a turn died on a provider error — and a tested wrapper script classifies transport vs task failures, resumes transport failures with bounded backoff, stops on a repeating deterministic failure, and verifies completion against a caller-supplied ground-truth predicate.

plugins.name: track
plugins.description: Spec-driven backlog: vision -> roadmap -> stories -> designs as in-repo markdown, with a deterministic status board generated from story frontmatter. Slash commands for the full story lifecycle, a self-orienting skill so any agent picks up the next ready story, and an impl-coord skill that works the backlog autonomously via parallel worktree implementors — artifact-based failing-first proofs, independent review, serial gated integration, a specified degraded mode when implementors cannot be spawned, and reversible-half release cutting.

plugins.name: rust-pro
plugins.description: Senior-Rust-engineer skill for safe, idiomatic, high-performance Rust (2024 edition). Progressive-disclosure references cover ownership & lifetimes, error handling (thiserror/anyhow), traits & generics, async & concurrency (Tokio), testing, and Cargo project structure & tooling.
